Growth Mindset Capability Evolution Across Three Changes

nodes.label: Leaderboard API
nodes.rationale: A single server avoids browser-local leaderboards that cannot be shared across players.

nodes.label: Start Countdown Scheduler
nodes.rationale: Auto-start with a cancellable countdown; countdown time is excluded from the 20-second round.

nodes.label: Fastify Instruction Route
nodes.rationale: Server-only provider keeps credentials off the browser and preserves the existing API ownership boundary.

nodes.label: Integrity Pure Fixed-Step Engine
nodes.rationale: Pure deterministic code can be tested without a DOM or real time; React is a thin renderer.

nodes.label: Offline Word Bank Generation
nodes.rationale: LLM candidates are generated offline and human-reviewed before commit; the game never calls an LLM at runtime.

nodes.label: Raw Score Preservation
nodes.rationale: The game shows its raw score, served count, and wrong count without reinterpretation.

nodes.label: Moving Solution Lane
nodes.rationale: Stationary customer targets with a moving solution lane avoid unfair moving drop targets and preserve keyboard parity.

nodes.label: One-Cell Board Move Legality
nodes.rationale: Both deterministic parsing and structured provider guidance are used so a schema-valid model output cannot move the wrong duplicate.

nodes.label: Score Normalization to 0-100
nodes.rationale: Raw score has a wider range than the host contract; preserve the raw result and normalize only at the onComplete boundary.

nodes.label: PlayableGame
nodes.rationale: The game owns its mechanic and computes one integer score in [0,100]; the shell owns value validation, deduplication, transitions, and total calculation.

nodes.label: Developer guardrails and checks decision
nodes.rationale: CI can check structure and contracts, while review verifies art provenance and design quality.

nodes.label: Game contract and score lifecycle decision
nodes.norm_label: game contract and score lifecycle decision
nodes.rationale: Preferable to a shared mutable score store that would let one module modify another developer's results.

nodes.label: Shell and directory ownership decision
nodes.rationale: Gives each owner isolation without multiplying deployment, accessibility, and score-transport problems.

nodes.label: Ranking and trust boundary decision
nodes.rationale: Because this is an unauthenticated, non-prize leaderboard, shape checks and rate limiting are the initial boundary; trustworthy competition would require server-verifiable game events and identity in a later change.

nodes.label: Visual direction and asset policy decision
nodes.norm_label: visual direction and asset policy decision
nodes.rationale: Original five-stops motif avoids replicating the Kampung Bash reference's menus or mini-game content.

nodes.label: Growth Mindset Game Capability
nodes.rationale: The Growth Mindset stage had a slot but no playable game, so the journey could not be finished.

nodes.label: 65-Point Pass Gate
nodes.rationale: The owner wants a 65-point pass mark so the stage shows real mastery before the player moves on.
